novel_features.name: Offline research-grounding search
novel_features.description: Ranked full-text search over your synced library — title, abstract, creators, tags, and attachment full text — answered offline in under a second, with snippets and citation-ready metadata.
novel_features.rationale: Pairs SQLite FTS5 with version-based incremental sync; no other Zotero tool has both, so every grounding query costs the network and the rate limit.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when asked what the user's own library says about a topic.

novel_features.name: Recently-added triage
novel_features.description: What landed in the library recently, sorted by dateAdded from the local cache, with a --days cutoff and pipeable keys.
novel_features.rationale: Pure local ORDER BY over the synced cache; pairs with export for dropping fresh citations into a manuscript.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for weekly triage of new additions.

novel_features.name: Citekey bridge
novel_features.description: Resolves a Better BibTeX citekey to its item from the local cache and exports citekey-faithful BibTeX; sync backfills citekeys via the desktop's local JSON-RPC when available.
novel_features.rationale: The Web API cannot know Better BibTeX citekeys; only a local bridge closes the gap between API exports and the citekeys manuscripts already use.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when a manuscript needs a citation by its Better BibTeX citekey.

novel_features.name: Cached collection tree
novel_features.description: Renders the full collection hierarchy with per-node item counts in one command — a shape the flat API cannot return in one call.
novel_features.rationale: Recursive assembly over the local collections table plus the item-collection join; the live API requires N+1 requests for the same view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for a hierarchical overview of how the library is organized.

novel_features.name: Cache health and offline reindex
novel_features.description: Sync cursors, row and FTS counts, and last-sync age from the local cache; 'cache reindex' rebuilds the FTS index from base tables with zero network.
novel_features.rationale: The FTS index is rebuildable locally; without this the only corruption remedy is a full network resync.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to check cache freshness offline before trusting search results.

narrative.headline: Your entire Zotero research library, searchable offline — version-based incremental sync into SQLite with full-text search no other Zotero tool has.
narrative.value_prop: zotero-research-library-pp-cli mirrors your library into a local SQLite cache using the API's version cursors, then answers research-grounding questions offline: ranked full-text search with snippets, collection trees, recent-additions triage, and Better BibTeX citekey lookups. What the Web API meters at 100 items a page, your cache answers in milliseconds.
narrative.auth_narrative: Create an API key at zotero.org/settings/keys and set ZOTERO_API_KEY (or run auth set-token). The CLI resolves your numeric userID automatically via /keys/current and stores the library-prefixed base URL in config — you never need to look up your user ID.

quickstart.comment: Verify config shape without touching the API
First full mirror of items, collections, tags, and full text
The grounding ritual: what does my library say about this?
What did I add this week
The library's shape at a glance

troubleshoots.fix: Key lacks library access — regenerate at zotero.org/settings/keys with 'Allow library access' checked
The cache is empty — run 'sync --full' first; check 'cache status' for cursors and row counts
Citekeys come from the Better BibTeX plugin via the desktop app — open Zotero desktop and re-run 'sync'

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI whenever a task needs the user's own research library: grounding answers in their curated corpus, finding citations, browsing collections, or exporting BibTeX. It is the substrate for research-grounding workflows — search the local cache first, fall back to live API or open web only when the cache misses.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to create, modify, or delete items in Zotero — it is read-only against the API
Do not use it for PDF download or attachment file retrieval; it indexes extracted text only
Do not use it for open-web literature search — it covers the user's own library

recipes.title: Research-grounding query
recipes.command: zotero-research-library-pp-cli ground "return to play criteria" --limit 10 --agent --select key,title,creators,date,DOI
recipes.explanation: Offline ranked search with citation-ready fields; the first step of the grounding workflow.

recipes.title: Full-text deep search
recipes.explanation: Extends the search into attachment full text and resolves hits to their parent papers.

recipes.title: Weekly additions to BibTeX
recipes.explanation: Fresh additions ready to pipe into an export.

recipes.title: Scope a search to a collection
recipes.explanation: Collection-scoped grounding using the local join table.

recipes.title: Live server-side search fallback
recipes.explanation: When you need unsynced server state, the generated endpoint carries the API's full search grammar.
